cards.name: Aethermoeba
cards.rules:
Voidwalk

Moves by expanding from any part of itself. It occupies all locations it has ever occupied, and has +1 power for each one that is void.

cards.name: Altar of Malachai
cards.rules: Once per game, if you would die, you may sacrifice a minion atop this Altar instead.

cards.name: Animist
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

You may cast magics in your hand as Spirits with power equal to their cost.

cards.name: Archimago
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Banish three magic spells in your cemetery → Cast a copy of one of them.

cards.name: Avatar of Fire
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → This turn, fire sites in your hand are also Fireballs.

cards.name: Avatar of Water
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Flood a site adjacent to your body of water until you do so again. You may teleport there.

cards.name: Blasted Oak
cards.rules: If a spell or non-basic ability can target—in order of precedence—Blasted Oak, its site or location, or anything else at its site or location, it must.

cards.name: Book of Blessings
cards.rules: Whenever bearer casts magic that chooses a single allied minion, Ward that ally.

cards.name: Bureau of Occult Control
cards.rules: Players must pay (2) to access a collection or cemetery.

cards.name: Burning Hands
cards.rules: May be cast by an allied Mortal. Choose two different cardinal directions and deal damage to each unit at locations in the area of effect:

cards.name: Cage of Sidrak
cards.rules: Genesis → Lock all minions with 2 or less power in this cage, tapped and disabled.

cards.name: Captain Baldassare
cards.rules: Whenever Captain Baldassare attacks a unit or site, the defending player discards their topmost three spells. You may cast each of those spells once this turn, ignoring threshold requirements.

cards.name: Cerberus in Chains
cards.rules:
Must be summoned to your location.

Cerberus in Chains automatically follows you and can't move itself away.

cards.name: Chaos Twister
cards.rules: Place target minion on the back of your hand, then blow it off from a height of at least one foot. Deal damage equal to its power to each unit atop the site it lands on, including itself.

cards.name: Chaoswish
cards.rules: Cast a copy of a random spell for free, ignoring threshold, then the next player may copy Chaoswish.

cards.name: City of Souls
cards.rules: (E) — Provides (2) instead but enemies can redirect damage dealt to this site to any unit.

cards.name: Corpse Catapult
cards.rules: Tap bearer and another ally here, Banish a dead minion → Deal damage equal to the banished minion's power to each unit at target location up to three steps away.

cards.name: Corpse Explosion
cards.rules: Deal a dead minion to each site in a two-by-two area. Deal damage equal to each corpse's power to units there, then banish the corpses.

cards.name: Corruptor
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Your Beasts are Monsters, your Mortals are Undead, and your Angels are Demons.

cards.name: Courtesan Thaïs
cards.rules: Genesis → During their next turn, each player is controlled by the previous one.

cards.name: Crave Golem
cards.rules: At the start of each player's turn, Crave Golem attacks a random minion within its range of motion, or takes a step toward the closest minion if it can't.

cards.name: Dame Britomart
cards.rules:
Lance

If Dame Britomart would successfully attack an enemy site, she may summon a Mortal from your cemetery to her location instead.

cards.name: Darkest Dungeon
cards.rules: Genesis → The next time an ally strikes an Avatar this turn, drag both here if able.

cards.name: Day of Judgment
cards.rules: Place the cross anywhere in the realm. Banish Evil and damage units occupying affected squares.

cards.name: Deathspeaker
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

You may banish a dead minion each turn to cast a copy of it, and for (0) if you’re on Death’s Door. The copy enters the realm, uses its Genesis, then is banished.

cards.name: Demonic Contract
cards.rules:
Search your spellbook for any card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle afterward.
You may only search for a spell that has rarity lower or equal to a Demon minion that you control. As an additional cost to cast Demonic Contract you must pay 4 life, or reach another accord with said demon by sacrificing a coin, egg, frog, gem, goat, rune, treasure, or Mortal soul.

cards.name: Dhol Chants
cards.rules: Tap any number of nearby allies. Reveal that many spells from the top of your spellbook and cast one for free. Put the rest at the bottom of your spellbook.

cards.name: Dodge Roll
cards.rules:
May be cast when an ally is attacked.

An attacked ally may move to another adjacent location to evade the attack.

cards.name: Doomsday Device
cards.rules:
Doomsday Device enters the realm with 6 counters. At the end of each player’s turn, remove a counter. When the last is removed, it detonates!

Deals damage to each unit at affected locations:

cards.name: Dragonlord
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Before setup, set aside a Unique Dragon. Once on your turn, if you meet its threshold, you may pay (3) to gain its abilities this turn.

cards.name: Earthquake
cards.rules: You may rearrange sites within a two-by-two area, carrying along everything of normal size. Then burrow all minions and artifacts on those sites.

cards.name: Edge of the World
cards.rules: Must always be adjacent to the void.

cards.name: Enchantress
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Whenever you cast a spell, you may animate target aura until your next turn. It’s an aura minion with power equal to its cost.

cards.name: Felbog Frog Men
cards.rules: Can leap entirely over adjacent sites in one step.

cards.name: Firebreathing
cards.rules: May be cast by an allied Beast or Dragon. Choose a cardinal direction and deal damage to each unit at a location in the area of effect:

cards.name: Flame Strike
cards.rules: Choose a cardinal direction from the caster. Deal damage to each unit at affected locations:

cards.name: Flame Wave
cards.rules: Flame Wave flows horizontally, from one edge of the realm to the other. Deal damage to each unit atop sites in the area of effect:

cards.name: Free City
cards.rules: Once per turn, may attack or defend against enemy units here.

cards.name: Giant Shark
cards.rules:
Submerge, Waterbound

Whenever another unit enters or moves between sites in this body of water, Giant Shark moves to that unit to fight it.

cards.name: Gnarled Wendigo
cards.rules: This costs (2) less to cast for each minion you sacrifice at its summoning location.

cards.name: Grigori Rasputin
cards.rules:
Spellcaster

Banish an Evil ally → Cast Rasputin from your cemetery to there. He adds their power and abilities to his own until he dies again.

cards.name: Grösse Poltergeist
cards.rules: Tap → Until Grosse Poltergeist leaves the realm, gain control of a nearby artifact and animate it. It's an Automaton with power equal to its cost, and has its own bearer abilities.

cards.name: Hellstar
cards.rules: Airborne, can't attack or defend. At the start of your turn, each other unit at affected locations takes damage:

cards.name: Holy Nova
cards.rules: Deal damage to each enemy at affected locations. You may break an allied Ward to center this spell on that location instead of the caster's.

cards.name: I Am Colossus!
cards.rules: You may banish minions under your control, or from your hand or cemetery, to help cast the Colossus. It costs (1) less to cast for each.

cards.name: Imposter
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

(3) → Banish an Avatar from your collection to mask yourself. Gain their abilities until damaged or until you put on a new mask.

cards.name: Infusion Factory
cards.rules: Adjacent artifacts are Automatons with 2 power and their own bearer abilities.

cards.name: Jack the Ripper
cards.rules:
Stealth

May be cast to any Mortal, silencing then killing them, without breaking Stealth.

cards.name: Joust!
cards.rules: An ally targets an enemy they’re adjacent to, then they both take a step to swap places. If they pass each other, they fight.

cards.name: Kairos the Archivist
cards.rules:
Genesis → Archive the state of the realm.
Deathrite → Return all archived cards to their recorded state. Then banish Kairos.

cards.name: Karkemish Chimera
cards.rules: Can simultaneously attack up to three units at the same location.

cards.name: Key to the City
cards.rules:
Provides (1).

Bearer ignores site abilities.

cards.name: Koschei's Egg
cards.rules: Genesis → Avatar bearer hides its soul in Koschei's Egg, becoming immune to death blows. After three of your turns, or if the Egg leaves the realm, you lose.

cards.name: Lava Flow
cards.rules: Lava flows from the caster's site in a cardinal direction. Deal damage to each other unit occupying a site in the area of effect:

cards.name: Led Astray
cards.rules: Choose any number of enemies at target location. They take a step together to another location they're adjacent to.

cards.name: Magellan Globe
cards.rules: Opposite edges of the realm are connected.

cards.name: Magician
cards.rules:
You have no atlas, but your spellbook may contain sites, and you start with seven cards.

Tap → Play a site.

cards.name: Megamoeba
cards.rules: Megamoeba moves by extending a single pseudopod from any part of itself. It occupies all locations it has ever occupied, and has +1 power for each.

cards.name: Mephistopheles
cards.rules:
Must be cast to your Avatar's location, taking their life and replacing them as your Avatar.

Once on your turn, you may summon an Evil minion from your hand to an adjacent site.

cards.name: Mester Stoor Worm
cards.rules:
Submerge, Waterbound

Tap → Choose a direction from Mester Stoor Worm. Deal Lethal damage to each unit at a location in the area of effect:

cards.name: Meteor Shower
cards.rules: Target three sites that share no borders. Deal damage to each unit atop sites in each area of effect:

cards.name: Mimic
cards.rules: As you summon this Mimic, you may transform a carriable artifact into it, under your control.

cards.name: Mismanaged Mortuary
cards.rules: Flooded. Treat your opponent's cemetery as yours, and vice versa.

cards.name: Monastery Gargoyle
cards.rules: At the start and end of your turn, choose whether Monastery Gargoyle has Airborne or is a Monument.

cards.name: Mortal Soil
cards.rules: Whenever an affected site takes damage, banish a minion from your cemetery to prevent it. If you can't, dispel this.

cards.name: Mount Ussar Sanctuary
cards.rules: (E)(E)(E)(E) — When your Avatar arrives at Death's Door, they flee here and gain Ward.

cards.name: Mudslide
cards.rules: Genesis → Slide all units at land sites in this column one step left or right.

cards.name: Orb of Ba'al Berith
cards.rules: The first time each turn a Magic spell is cast nearby, Orb of Ba'al Berith creates a copy. The spell's controller may choose new targets.

cards.name: Order of the White Wing
cards.rules:
Ward

If a minion would be summoned nearby and it wasn't cast from hand, banish it.

cards.name: Orpheus' Crossing
cards.rules: Genesis → You're on Death's Door until your next turn. Summon a dead minion here.

cards.name: Pathfinder
cards.rules:
Your atlas can’t contain duplicates. Draw no sites during setup.

Tap → If able, play the topmost site of your atlas to an adjacent location and move there.

cards.name: Persecutor
cards.rules:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Once on your turn, Persecutor may step toward the closest Evil, or brand an enemy so your cards treat them as Evil this turn.

cards.name: Putrid Presence
cards.rules:
Submerge, Burrowing

The subsurface of nearby sites can be attacked.

cards.name: Realm-Eater
cards.rules:
Tap → Play, draw, or digest a site.

Destroys sites it successfully attacks, then becomes immobile until it digests.

cards.name: Red Rock of Ravannis
cards.rules:
Artifacts can't be carried here.

At the end of each turn, pull each artifact one step towards this site, along with its bearer.

cards.name: Rift Valley
cards.rules: You may pull apart a partial row or column to make a void in which to play this.

cards.name: Royal Bodyguard
cards.rules: If a nearby Avatar or royalty (King, Queen, Prince, or Princess) would take damage, Royal Bodyguard may take that damage instead.

cards.name: Saint of Redemption
cards.rules:
Ward

No minion is Evil, but all enter the realm tapped.

cards.name: Sea Raider
cards.rules: Whenever Sea Raider attacks and kills an enemy, its controller discards their topmost spell. You may cast that spell once this turn, ignoring threshold.

cards.name: Sir Gawain
cards.rules: Sir Gawain takes damage for other adjacent allies. If he dies from damage taken this way, draw a card.

cards.name: Snowball
cards.rules: Shoot a piercing projectile. It picks up all other units along its path and carries them with it. When it stops, units there take damage equal to the number of units in the snowball.

cards.name: Stitched Abomination
cards.rules: Genesis → Banish up to three minions from one cemetery to stitch together. This Abomination has their combined power, but each part may be damaged and destroyed separately.

cards.name: Tabula Rasa
cards.rules:
May be cast to any minion.

Bearer is silenced, can't be modified otherwise, and can't drop Tabula Rasa.

cards.name: The Apex of Babel
cards.rules: When the Tower of Babel is built, draw a spell, then you may cast a spell for free.

cards.name: The Base of Babel
cards.rules: You may build The Tower of Babel by playing The Apex of Babel atop this.

cards.name: The Flood
cards.rules: Permanently flood the entire realm, including voids. Submerge everything except one minion of each type.

cards.name: The Immortal Throne
cards.rules:
Whenever anyone plays a card with cost equal to the number of level counters on The Immortal Throne, they draw a card and add a level counter.

At level 8 or more, an Avatar here alone wins the game.

cards.name: The Inquisition
cards.rules:
When an opponent can see this card in your hand or spellbook, you may summon it.

Genesis → Target opponent reveals their hand. You may banish a card from it.

cards.name: The Malleus Maleficarum
cards.rules: Once on your turn, bearer may cast a magic from your collection that targets an enemy Spellcaster, or their location or site.

cards.name: The Pallid Bust
cards.rules:
Genesis → Banish a dead minion.

Minion bearer has the banished minion's printed types and abilities.

cards.name: The Rack
cards.rules: Whenever the bearer strikes an Avatar, stretch them so that they also occupy another adjacent location. Then they lose 1 life for each location they occupy.

cards.name: The Void
cards.rules: This site is also void.

cards.name: Tombstone Wardens
cards.rules: During your opponent's turn, this is a 5 power Angel Automaton with Airborne.

cards.name: Tringh Constrictor
cards.rules: Tap → Tringh Constrictor may take a step, then it constricts target minion here and carries it disabled. The next time Tringh Constrictor would untap, it instead kills that minion if it's still constricted.

cards.name: Valor
cards.rules: May be cast when an ally defends a site or another unit. The ally gains +4 power this turn.

cards.name: Vindictive Nation
cards.rules: Opponent loses 1, 3, or 7 life respectively if they modify, move, or destroy a nearby allied site.

cards.name: Vivien the Enchantress
cards.rules: Vivien has the other printed abilities of all Avatars and Spellcasters in the realm, wherever she is.

cards.name: Wave of Eviction
cards.rules: An allied water site overflows in a cardinal direction, flooding sites there this turn and carrying away enemies one step at a time.

cards.name: Wormelow Tump
cards.rules: (E)(E)(E) – Opponents can't affect cards in your cemetery.

cards.name: Wreathed in Righteousness
cards.rules: Ward all minions at target location. Then deal damage to minions at affected locations:

cards.name: Yog-Sothoth
cards.rules:
Occupies all locations safely.

Is banished without five voids.

Ignores the abilities of sites.
